question:
Simplify 

4 (1)/(4) times 4 (1)/(4)-2 times 4 (1)/(4) times (1)/(4)+(1)/(4) times (1)/(4)
solution:
**Simplify:**

4 (1)/(4) times 4 (1)/(4)-2 times 4 (1)/(4) times (1)/(4)+(1)/(4) times (1)/(4)

**Formula used:**

Convert mixed fractions to improper fractions for simplification

**Calculations:**

4 ¹/₄ = (4 × 4 + 1) ÷ 4 = 17 ÷ 4

⇒ The expression becomes:

(17 ÷ 4) × (17 ÷ 4) - 2 × (17 ÷ 4) × (1 ÷ 4) + (1 ÷ 4) × (1 ÷ 4)

⇒ (289 ÷ 16) - (2 × 17 ÷ 16) + (1 ÷ 16)

⇒ (289 ÷ 16) - (34 ÷ 16) + (1 ÷ 16)

⇒ (289 - 34 + 1) ÷ 16

⇒ 256 ÷ 16

⇒ 16

**∴ The simplified value is 16.**
